messages:
maya: FYI staging canary blocked — deploy-bot showing multipart shard prefetch failing for build #5821 at 14:20 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/5821
ravi: logs: GET /artifacts/sha256:abc123/shard-7 -> 504 (curl exit 28). snippet:
```nGET /artifacts/sha256:abc123/shard-7/prefetch -> 504
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000 ms
```
deploy-bot: auto-retry 3/3 exhausted, promotion paused.
tess: change-window at 15:00 PT. do we wait or pin previous?
omar: options:
- wait 30m and retry if transient
- manual promote last-good image (sha256:def456) to meet window
- quarantine 5821 and reupload artifacts
ravi: storage says a GC compaction spike at 14:18 increased GET latency; most objects OK but shard-7 still timing out.
sre-oncall: recommend manual promote to avoid missing SLAs; storage will rehydrate shard.
maya: decision?
tess: I'll own release notes if we promote.
omar: promote last-good image. @deploy-bot promote sha256:def456 to canary; quarantine 5821.
deploy-bot: running: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:def456 --reason "artifact prefetch timeout build 5821"`
deploy-bot: promote succeeded — canary now on sha256:def456, routing updated.
ravi: storage will attempt rehydrate + prefetch; we can rerun CI for 5821 after artifacts verified.
tess: updating release notes and filing a bug linking quarantined build. :memo:
maya: marking change-window met. escalate if recurrence. :thumbsup:
